BiblicalUsage: Bozkath means rocky height, and it is named twice, as a town of Judah and as a mother's home. In Joshua 15:39 it is listed among the lowland towns of Judah, and in 2 Kings 22:1 Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Boscath is named as the mother of Josiah, the king who found the book of the law.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Bozkath is remembered for a mother: Jedidah of Boscath, whose son Josiah turned the kingdom back to the book.
